{{Top}} {{Otheruses|unidentified Imperial warlord}} {{SpoilerFilm}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:UnidentifiedImperialwarlord2-MandoandGrogutrailer2.png]] |name=Unidentified Imperial warlord 2 |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=White, later graying |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Neo-Imperial forces]] **[[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Long live the Empire.|The Warlord|{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}}}} A '''warlord''' was a member of the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]] for the [[Neo-Imperial forces|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. During a shadow council meeting, The [[warlord]] acknowledged [[Unidentified Imperial warlord 1|another]]'s belief that there were loyal citizens of the [[Galactic Empire]] on every [[planet]], and the warlord believed that if the Shadow Council gave them a show of strength, these citizens would rally behind them against the New Republic. Later, the warlord met with a group on individuals, during which time he chanted the phrase "[[Long live the Empire]]." ==Biography== {{Quote|There are citizens loyal to the Empire on every planet in this galaxy. They are already getting sick of this New Republic and its rules and regulations.''"
"''And if we give them a show of strength, they will rally behind us.|Another warlord and the Imperial warlord in a Shadow Council meeting|audio=ThereAreCitizensLoyalToTheEmpire-TheSpies.flac|}} [[File:Warlord2-TheSpies.png|thumb|250px|right|The warlord attended a meeting of the Shadow Council]] A [[warlord]] of one of the [[Neo-Imperial forces|neo-imperialist remnants]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] was active in the [[New Republic Era]], holding a seat in the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]], a group of [[Imperial officer]]s who secretly cooperated to conceal their true strength. In [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|23}} the warlord attended a meeting of the Shadow Council via [[hologram]]. During the meeting, a [[Unidentified Imperial warlord 1|warlord]] on the council stated their belief that there were citizens loyal to the Empire on every planet in [[the galaxy]] and were sick of the New Republic, its rules, and its regulations, to which the warlord responded with their opinion that if they were to perform a show of strength, the loyal citizens would rally behind the Empire once again. Following their statement, the warlord watched [[Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon]] as they responded that such strength should not be wasted, before the captain then remindinded the council that [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]'s planned return would hearld in a resurgence of their [[Imperial Military|military]] and give [[Commandant]] [[Brendol Hux]] enough time to deliver on [[Project Necromancer]]. Later in the meeting, the warlord joined his colleagues on the Shadow Council in chanting "[[Long live the Empire]]," a [[Neo-Imperialism|neo-Imperialist]] phrase inherited from Imperials who once used the phrase during the [[Imperial Era]].{{TOTE|Devoted}} Later, the warlord met in person with a group on individuals at a room guarded by [[Cold weather assault trooper]]s located in a mountainous and [[Water|snowy]] location, during which time they once again chanted the phrase "Long live the Empire." ==Personality and traits== The warlord was a tan-skinned [[human]] with white and dark grey hair. ==Equipment== The commander wore a dark grey [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a [[belt]] and a [[Rank insignia plaque]] on their [[breast]] with 2 red tiles on the plaque's top row and two blue tiles on the plaque's bottom row. In addition, the warlord wore a black jacket that held tan fur inside. While attending a meeting of the Shadow Council, the warlord wore black gloves and a [[Imperial kepi]] that both matched their officer's uniform and held a [[Officer's disk]]. However, during a later in-person meeting, the warlord did not wear the gloves and kepi. ==Behind the scenes== The warlord first appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' which was released on [[April 12]], [[2023]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}} The warlord was portrayed by [[Hemky Madera]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 3|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 3]] {{Hologram}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} {{1st}} {{Hologram}} *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|224|Who's the Boss?}} {{Imo}} *{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი იმპერიელი მხედართმთავარი 2 }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial warlords]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Shadow Council members]]
